channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Social Security COLA for 2027 Will Be 3.6%
item.description: The cost of living adjustment, or COLA, for next year will be the largest since 2023. Retirees will see the extra money in their benefit checks starting in January.

item.title: NPR: Inflation sizzled in September — and Social Security benefits will get a boost
item.description: Consumer prices in September jumped 3.7% from a year ago. The Social Security Administration said benefits will increase next year to help keep pace with the rising cost of living.

item.title: BBC News: Russell Brand was a 'sexual predator', says prosecution as rape trial begins
item.description: The actor and comedian has pleaded not guilty to three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.
